title: A day is a mix of activities
hook: Two stated cases: explore the time weights behind an average experience score.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the time weights behind an average experience score affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Rate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the time weights behind an average experience score in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
